text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, before the autumn Tenno Sho, Daiwa Scarlet summons Vodka to meet her somewhere unusual.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka. You're here.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I wanted to talk alone before the race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right. But why at the planetarium?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It's just for a change of pace, since we'd probably end up arguing like usual anywhere else.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Don't worry. I rented the entire place out. We can talk all we want.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whirrrr!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I really don't understand the way you think.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Just when I thought you went to the Derby, you came back to the Tiara tour. Then you ran the Arima Kinen, followed by mile races…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And now the autumn Tenno Sho? If your career was a constellation, it would be the Jumble constellation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure that's not a constellation…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Because it doesn't make sense! Just like your career! I have no idea what it is you're trying to do.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I want to race you. I want to beat you. But are you even trying to seriously compete with me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't run just to compete with you, ya know. It's like…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I think we have different kinds of constellations.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What does that even mean?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's like you've got a picture all picked out in your head, and you're tracing the dots you need to make Virgo or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But I'm not fillin' in someone else's constellation. I'm pickin' whatever stars I like.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: If all you do is scrape together random stars, though… they're not going to form a constellation at all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: They don't have to. I don't really care about the big picture.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I care about each, individual star.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Each… star?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer and I only choose races that I want to run in from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The junior G1, the Oka Sho, the Derby, the Yasuda Kinen—they were all unforgettable races.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It may look like nonsense to you, with your nose in your preset star chart.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But to me… each star has meanin'! And I won't give that up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: My constellation might look like a jumble, but it's a collection of the very brightest stars.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A collection of… the brightest stars?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I've seen plenty of stars that someone like you walkin' along the beaten track could never see.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And I've pulled them all together into my constellation. Even though they're scattered, and no two are the same.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You don't understand how awesome that is. That's all I'm sayin'.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: O-of course I don't understand. No one would!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You will after the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In fact, I'm goin' to the Tenno Sho just so I can show ya.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: My path may look like aimlessly drifting stardust in your eyes. But, to me, that path has more meaning than anything else!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho is the big race where I finally put my new technique into action and face off against you, the number one.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I… I promised myself I wouldn't stand in front of ya until I became the me I wanted to be.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And now the time has come. That's why I'm standin' here now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So whaddya think? Still think I'm no match for ya?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I don't get it. Even if I think I get it in my head, I don't get it in my heart. But…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I guess it's better that I don't understand. If I understood my opponent, it wouldn't be much of a competition.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: After all, if we understood each other, it's obvious I'd be the winner since I'm number one.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's why you're my rival.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Fine. Bring it on! This next race is the real showdown between your technique and mine!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's settle this. We'll both have a full tank and a full tune-up! May the best racer win!
